# Product identities

SVG icons were obtained from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) on 2026-10-13. The collection is published under CC0; its license is included in `LICENSE-simple-icons.md`.

`ollama.svg` was downloaded unchanged on 2026-10-13 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/develop/icons/ollama.svg under the same CC0 license. The collection identifies the upstream logo source as https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/2152#issuecomment-1905286922. It is a standalone monochrome SVG with a `0 0 24 24` viewBox and no external dependencies.

PNG images are the public project-owner avatars from their official GitHub repositories:

- `crm.png`: https://github.com/espocrm/espocrm
- `tasks.png`: https://github.com/hcengineering/platform
- `automation.png`: https://github.com/activepieces/activepieces

`mailu.png` is the official transparent Mailu logomark, downloaded on 2026-10-13 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailu/Mailu/master/docs/assets/logomarkv2.png. Source repository: https://github.com/Mailu/Mailu. The repository's MIT license is included in `LICENSE-mailu.md`. The image is used unchanged.

The identities identify the software available for implementation. They do not imply partnership or endorsement.
